name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
target_group: Girl child below the prescribed age at account opening
eligibility: Account can be opened for an eligible girl child under the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Rules.
benefits: Government-backed small-savings account designed for the financial future of a girl child.
documents: Photograph and account-opening documents as required
application_process: Open the account through an authorised bank or post office under the official Sukanya Samriddhi process.
source: Department of Economic Affairs / Government of India
